definition: תָּכֵּנִית noun feminine measurement, proportion ; — absolute Ezek 43:10 (< read תָּכְּ נִיתוֺ ᵐ5 Ew Hi Co Toy and others); ׳ חוֺתֵם ת Ezek 28:12 thou wert one sealing up (the) measure ( RVm ), i.e. exhibiting perfect proportion; Manuscripts Sm and others ׳ חוֺחַם ת the seal of (perfect) proportion ; but dubious, see Commentaries
